lines.zh: 我走进村子，没人再向我点头。
lines.en: I walk into the village; no one nods to me now.

lines.zh: 手还交叠在袖子里，像从前。
lines.en: My hands stay folded in my sleeves, as before.

lines.zh: 这条石板路，我修过两回。
lines.en: I repaired this stone path twice.

lines.zh: 脚上是旧鞋，鞋底早磨穿了。
lines.en: Old shoes on my feet, the soles worn through.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂走，麦子倒向一边。
lines.en: I walk the field ridge; the wheat leans away.

lines.zh: 经过钟楼时，我停了好久。
lines.en: I paused a long time by the bell tower.

lines.zh: 我记得每家的门朝哪边开。
lines.en: I remember which way every door opens.

lines.zh: 走得很慢，像还拎着菜篮。
lines.en: I walk slowly, as if still carrying a basket.

lines.zh: 有人关了窗，木板响了一声。
lines.en: Someone shut a window; the shutter knocked.

lines.zh: 绕过井口，我从不踩井沿。
lines.en: I go around the well; I never step on its rim.

lines.zh: 肩膀一高一低，走起来一歪。
lines.en: My shoulders sit uneven; I walk crooked.

lines.zh: 村里的狗不叫了，只低着头抖。
lines.en: The village dogs stopped barking and only shiver.

lines.zh: 喉咙里还会发出嗯嗯的声音。
lines.en: A low hum still comes from my throat.

lines.zh: 我收起手，像在等一笔买卖。
lines.en: I fold my hands as if waiting for a trade.

lines.zh: 绿宝石在我兜里，早不亮了。
lines.en: Emeralds in my pocket; they stopped shining.

lines.zh: 工作台还在，我的活却停了。
lines.en: The workbench stands; my work is finished.

lines.zh: 我闻着面包的味道，站在门外。
lines.en: I smell bread and stand outside the door.

lines.zh: 嗓子里有土，说不出整句。
lines.en: There is soil in my throat; words come broken.

lines.zh: 我替这户人家点过灯。
lines.en: I once lit this household's lamp each night.

lines.zh: 床上还有褶子，人却不在了。
lines.en: The bed still has creases; the person is gone.

lines.zh: 我数着窗格，一共九块。
lines.en: I count the window panes: nine of them.

lines.zh: 钟响过两声，我才抬一次头。
lines.en: The bell rang twice before I looked up once.

lines.zh: 手里捏着一枚生锈的铜板。
lines.en: A rusted copper coin sits in my fingers.

lines.zh: 他们从桥上过，绕着我走。
lines.en: They cross the bridge, walking around me.

lines.zh: 这块地我种过三季麦子。
lines.en: I farmed three seasons of wheat here.

lines.zh: 门内侧有划痕，是我留的。
lines.en: There are marks inside the door; I made them.

lines.zh: 你是生面孔，可我不招呼了。
lines.en: You are new here, but I no longer greet guests.

lines.zh: 你的背包里，有绿宝石吗？
lines.en: Do you have emeralds in that pack?

lines.zh: 别伸手，我不做买卖了。
lines.en: Don't reach out; I no longer trade.

lines.zh: 你穿得像流浪商人，我认得。
lines.en: You dress like a wandering trader; I know the look.

lines.zh: 进村的人，从前都会先敲门。
lines.en: People entering the village used to knock first.

lines.zh: 我腐烂的鼻尖，先闻你袖口里的粮食。
lines.en: My rotting nose sniffs the grain in your sleeve first.

lines.zh: 你的衣领上，有个村的记号。
lines.en: There's a village mark on your collar.

lines.zh: 我想说欢迎，喉咙只发出咕噜。
lines.en: I want to say welcome; only a gurgle comes out.

lines.zh: 你身后那扇门，是我家的。
lines.en: That door behind you was mine.

lines.zh: 我抬手想指路，手没抬起来。
lines.en: I raise a hand to point the way; it won't lift.

lines.zh: 你也住这种土房子吗？
lines.en: Do you also live in a house of mud?

lines.zh: 看你的鞋，是走了很远的路。
lines.en: Judging by your boots, you walked far.

lines.zh: 我从前会先问你要买什么。
lines.en: I used to ask what you wanted to buy.

lines.zh: 站远一点，我怕我身上的土。
lines.en: Stand back; I fear the soil on me.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我没眨眼。
lines.en: You look up at me, and I do not blink.

lines.zh: 我看你手里的面包，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at the bread in your hand for a long while.

lines.zh: 你的门牌我认得，是我刻的。
lines.en: I know your doorplate; I carved it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你脚边那只篮子。
lines.en: I stare at the basket by your feet.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打歪，我又站直。
lines.en: That knocked me crooked; I straightened again.

lines.zh: 我的袖子破了，里面是空的。
lines.en: My sleeve tore; there is nothing inside.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，没断。
lines.en: A bone clicked; it did not break.

lines.zh: 别打脸，我还想认得自己。
lines.en: Not the face; I still want to know myself.

lines.zh: 我退到墙边，扶着柜台。
lines.en: I back to the wall and hold the counter.

lines.zh: 你打掉了我兜里的铜板。
lines.en: You knocked the copper coin from my pocket.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，像从前那样。
lines.en: I let out a hum, the way I used to.

lines.zh: 水里泡过的身体，很怕火。
lines.en: A body soaked in water fears fire.

lines.zh: 这一棍打断了我半句招呼。
lines.en: That blow cut my greeting in half.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，慢慢把土捡回来。
lines.en: I crouch and slowly gather the soil back.

lines.zh: 绿宝石一晃，我的头就跟着转。
lines.en: An emerald flashes, and my head turns after it.

lines.zh: 拿面包来，我可以站着不动。
lines.en: Bring bread and I will stand still.

lines.zh: 甜菜根的甜味，我还没忘。
lines.en: I have not forgotten the sweetness of beetroot.

lines.zh: 你手里那枚钱，叮当一声。
lines.en: That coin in your hand made a chiming sound.

lines.zh: 我把手伸出来，掌心是空的。
lines.en: I hold out my hand; the palm is empty.

lines.zh: 土豆的泥还没干，给我看看。
lines.en: The potato still has wet dirt; let me see it.

lines.zh: 价钱我不谈了，东西放地上。
lines.en: I won't haggle; just put it on the ground.

lines.zh: 闻到烤面包，我走直线。
lines.en: Smelling baked bread, I walk in a straight line.

lines.zh: 口袋里响的，是硬币还是骨头？
lines.en: What rattles in your pocket, coins or bones?

lines.zh: 只要一样东西，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Just one thing, and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 我撞到门框，灰落了一肩。
lines.en: I bumped the doorframe; ash fell on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 别挤，我的胳膊是僵的。
lines.en: Don't push; my arms are stiff.

lines.zh: 两个人错身，我让得太慢。
lines.en: Two of us passed; I yielded too slowly.

lines.zh: 篮子翻了，里面的东西是空的。
lines.en: The basket tipped; there was nothing inside.

lines.zh: 你碰我的袖子，布就裂了。
lines.en: You brushed my sleeve, and the cloth split.

lines.zh: 我在门口卡住，肩膀过不去。
lines.en: I caught in the doorway; my shoulder wouldn't fit.

lines.zh: 推车撞过来，我退到墙边。
lines.en: A cart rolled into me; I stepped to the wall.

lines.zh: 牛撞了我一下，它闻了闻就走。
lines.en: An ox bumped me, sniffed, and walked off.

lines.zh: 我碰到钟绳，钟响得很闷。
lines.en: I brushed the bell rope; the bell rang dull.

lines.zh: 他们绕开我，像绕开一摊水。
lines.en: They went around me like around a puddle.

lines.zh: 我的屋子里，没有第二个人。
lines.en: There is no second person in my house.

lines.zh: 媒人来过，那时我还活着。
lines.en: A matchmaker came, back when I was alive.

lines.zh: 死人不娶亲，也不摆酒。
lines.en: The dead don't marry or hold feasts.

lines.zh: 同类走来，我们只是并排坐着。
lines.en: Another like me sits down; we just sit side by side.

lines.zh: 井边那对影子，不是我们的。
lines.en: Those two shadows by the well aren't ours.

lines.zh: 我记着一个人的名字，却想不起脸。
lines.en: I remember a name but not the face.

lines.zh: 喜字褪色了，还贴在门上。
lines.en: The wedding paper faded but still clings to the door.

lines.zh: 没有人愿意和我同住一间屋。
lines.en: No one will share a room with me now.

lines.zh: 我们不牵手，手指会掉。
lines.en: We don't hold hands; fingers would come off.

lines.zh: 坟里并排两个坑，空着一个。
lines.en: Two graves side by side; one is still empty.

lines.zh: 地上有块面包，我捡起来闻。
lines.en: Bread on the ground; I pick it up and sniff.

lines.zh: 我把绿宝石收进袖子，一颗。
lines.en: I tuck away one emerald in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这枚铜板，够买一碗汤。
lines.en: This copper coin would buy a bowl of soup.

lines.zh: 弯腰很慢，我扶着墙。
lines.en: I bend slowly, holding on to the wall.

lines.zh: 掉下的种子，我一颗颗捡。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen seeds one by one.

lines.zh: 捡到布头，我叠好放兜里。
lines.en: I find cloth scraps, fold them, pocket them.

lines.zh: 这根木棍能当拐杖。
lines.en: This stick of wood will serve as a cane.

lines.zh: 别人丢的鞋，我试了试。
lines.en: Someone dropped a shoe; I tried it on.

lines.zh: 腐肉我也收，别浪费。
lines.en: I take rotten flesh too; nothing is wasted.

lines.zh: 东西捡起来，就放回原处。
lines.en: I pick things up, then put them back.

lines.zh: 你把门推开了，那就是邀请。
lines.en: You pushed the door open; that is an invitation.

lines.zh: 村里人跑光了，只剩你。
lines.en: The villagers ran off; only you remain.

lines.zh: 我记得你的味道，上次在集市。
lines.en: I know your smell; last time at the market.

lines.zh: 你不敲门，我就当你是客人。
lines.en: You didn't knock, so I'll treat you as a guest.

lines.zh: 我在你背后站了很久才决定。
lines.en: I stood behind you a long while before deciding.

lines.zh: 你手里有绿宝石，也有热气。
lines.en: You carry emeralds and living warmth alike.

lines.zh: 目标就是你，别回头看钟。
lines.en: The target is you; don't look at the bell.

lines.zh: 我抬手示意，其实是在指你。
lines.en: I raise a hand as if greeting; I'm pointing at you.

lines.zh: 屋里有两个人，我选近的。
lines.en: Two people in the house; I pick the nearer.

lines.zh: 这条巷子只有一头能出去。
lines.en: This alley has only one way out.

lines.zh: 灯灭之后，我就知道是谁。
lines.en: When the lamp went out, I knew who it was.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁匠的烟味。
lines.en: You carry a blacksmith's smoke on you.

lines.zh: 交易开始，我不问价钱。
lines.en: The trade begins; I won't ask the price.

lines.zh: 我在柜台后面等你很久了。
lines.en: I have waited behind the counter a long time.

lines.zh: 你推开院门，我就站起来了。
lines.en: You push the gate open, and I stand up.

lines.zh: 你是这条街上唯一的活人。
lines.en: You are the only living one on this street.

lines.zh: 你跑过田，我沿着垄沟追。
lines.en: You ran through the field; I follow the furrows.

lines.zh: 我把手拢在袖里，走得稳稳的。
lines.en: Hands folded in my sleeves, I keep a steady pace.

lines.zh: 别进那间屋，我认得后门。
lines.en: Don't enter that house; I know the back door.

lines.zh: 你摔了一跤，我慢下来等你。
lines.en: You tripped; I slowed down to wait.

lines.zh: 钟敲一下，你就少一条路。
lines.en: Each bell toll takes away one of your roads.

lines.zh: 我在窗下走过，影子跟着你。
lines.en: I pass under the window; my shadow follows yours.

lines.zh: 你翻墙的样子，不太熟练。
lines.en: You don't climb that wall very well.

lines.zh: 这条街我走了四十年。
lines.en: I have walked this street for forty years.

lines.zh: 你回头看了三次，我都躲开了。
lines.en: You looked back three times; I hid each time.

lines.zh: 前面是磨坊，门是坏的。
lines.en: The mill is ahead, and its door is broken.

lines.zh: 我不喊，我怕吵到别人。
lines.en: I don't shout; I don't want to disturb anyone.

lines.zh: 你把篮子丢了，跑得更快了。
lines.en: You dropped your basket and ran faster.

lines.zh: 再往前就是坟地，我不熟。
lines.en: Past here is the graveyard; I know it less.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在地里，很难看不见。
lines.en: Your prints in the soil are hard to miss.

lines.zh: 你往井边走，我先到那儿。
lines.en: You head for the well, but I get there first.

lines.zh: 我学你的步子，慢了半拍。
lines.en: I copy your steps, half a beat behind.

lines.zh: 你钻进谷仓，我从后门进。
lines.en: You duck into the barn, and I come through the back.

lines.zh: 我跟得很好，只是想说话。
lines.en: I keep up well; I only wanted to talk.

lines.zh: 我抬手，像要递给你东西。
lines.en: I raise my hand as if handing you something.

lines.zh: 抓住手腕，比抓住衣领容易。
lines.en: Grabbing a wrist is easier than a collar.

lines.zh: 我推了你一把，力气不大。
lines.en: I shoved you once; not much force.

lines.zh: 指甲划过，留下两道土印。
lines.en: My nails rake, leaving two lines of dirt.

lines.zh: 你退到柜台边，我堵住出口。
lines.en: You backed to the counter; I block the exit.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的肩，牙齿松了。
lines.en: I bite your shoulder; my teeth come loose.

lines.zh: 这一拳很慢，你没躲开。
lines.en: This punch was slow, and you didn't dodge.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领子，布就烂了。
lines.en: I grip your collar, and the cloth rots.

lines.zh: 打完了，我还站在原地。
lines.en: The blow is done; I still stand here.

lines.zh: 我拍了拍你的头，像拍一件货。
lines.en: I pat your head as if patting merchandise.

lines.zh: 手臂甩出去，收不回来。
lines.en: My arm swings out and will not come back.

lines.zh: 我把你按在门上，门板响了。
lines.en: I press you to the door; the boards creak.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西掉了，我捡走了。
lines.en: Your things fell; I picked them up.

lines.zh: 我不追第二次，一次就够。
lines.en: I don't need a second try; one is enough.

lines.zh: 我用手背甩你，皮肉都僵。
lines.en: I backhand you, and my skin is stiff.

lines.zh: 这一下，是打谷场上的旧习惯。
lines.en: That swing is an old habit from the threshing floor.

lines.zh: 我从村口的土里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the dirt at the village gate.

lines.zh: 身上还穿着下葬时的衣服。
lines.en: I am still wearing my burial clothes.

lines.zh: 钟没响，我却醒了。
lines.en: The bell did not ring, yet I woke.

lines.zh: 我的手先动，腿后才跟上。
lines.en: My hands moved first; my legs caught up later.

lines.zh: 这户人家的门，我认得。
lines.en: I recognize the door of this household.

lines.zh: 我站起来，土从袖口往下漏。
lines.en: I stand, and soil spills from my cuffs.

lines.zh: 醒来时手里还提着空篮子。
lines.en: I woke still holding an empty basket.

lines.zh: 夜里风大，我的衣服贴在身上。
lines.en: The night wind is strong; my clothes stick to me.

lines.zh: 有人在耕地，我去看看。
lines.en: Someone is plowing; I'll go and look.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，先想起价钱。
lines.en: I open my mouth and think of prices first.

lines.zh: 村口第三个坑，是我的。
lines.en: The third grave at the village gate is mine.

lines.zh: 掌心的土，怎么也拍不掉。
lines.en: The dirt on my palms will not brush off.

lines.zh: 我出来了，狗先看见我。
lines.en: I came out; the dogs saw me first.

lines.zh: 我从地底爬回村口了。
lines.en: I climbed back up to the village gate.

lines.zh: 我从自家的坟里爬出来。
lines.en: I climbed out of my own grave.

lines.zh: 天没亮，我先去看了磨坊。
lines.en: Before dawn I went to check the mill.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，手里还有锄头。
lines.en: I woke with a hoe still in my hand.

lines.zh: 土里有根，我挣了很久。
lines.en: Roots held me down, and I fought them long.

lines.zh: 火苗上来，我的衣角先黑。
lines.en: The flame rises; my hem blackens first.

lines.zh: 从屋顶摔下，我的腿折了方向。
lines.en: I fell off the roof; my leg folds wrong.

lines.zh: 我在水里扑腾，像一袋麦子。
lines.en: I thrash in the water like a sack of wheat.

lines.zh: 炸起的碎石把我压在门下。
lines.en: Blast debris pins me under a door.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩头，我晃了一下。
lines.en: An arrow struck my shoulder; I wobbled.

lines.zh: 法术贴上皮肤，我的头发竖起来。
lines.en: The spell touches my skin; my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 肚子空得发响，我却吃不下。
lines.en: My belly growls, yet I cannot eat.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，衣服烧出洞。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and burned a hole.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界，篮子还提着。
lines.en: I fall out of the world, still holding my basket.
